summary.ownerCoverage: Active Owner accounts are selectable alongside employees. Employee assignment is not required. An additive XOR identity/FK migration preserves all employee coverage records and protects Owner history against lossy downgrade.
summary.swapProcessing: Removed duplicate assignment gates and warning rebuilds; batch training/replacement/profile facts within existing invalidated read scopes. Successful responses include the canonical updated board; the frontend updates in place and rejects duplicate submits.
summary.historicalIntegrity: Owner coverage grants no employee payroll/actual-work credit. Original shifts, absence evidence, coverage history, and explicit actual employee attendance remain authoritative.
